notes: Cash-basis (modified cash) school district; all funds incl. School Nutrition and Activities are 'Other Governmental Funds' on the statement, so no business-type funds. Receipts/disbursements/beginning/ending use the Total Governmental Funds columns (pp3-4); fund balance end 8,231,945 ties to the net position statement (p2) and assets (p5). Transfers: total column prints net blank; transfers in 130,000 (Activities) and out 130,000 (General 129,829 + Bond 171). Detail: General Fund recorded from the budget-and-actual schedule (pp7-10), more detailed than the combining schedule p6 (not double counted); it prints functions by program code, no object breakdown (not itemized). Hidden transfer: p6 Reclassifications column removes 118,400 from General Fund spending (95,000 to Depreciation, 23,400 to Employee Benefit); recorded as a contra line in the State categorical/Federal programs group plus an other financing line; General expenditure printed total 10,730,737 = items 10,482,337 + transfers out 130,000 + hidden 118,400. Employee Benefit 23,400 benefits spending sits under Instruction after reclassification. Interest and penalties 637 on p3 shown as property tax. Cooperative, Qualified Capital Purpose Undertaking and Student Fee fund schedules (pp15, 17, 18) had no actual receipts or disbursements (budget-only lines, not recorded); Bond Fund budget-only interfund loan repayment 1,048,443 not recorded. Group-level budget amounts (e.g. Support services - students 975,000) not attached to lines.
